turns.replyText:
Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes. A damaged item is handled differently from a standard return.

For live plants:

We do not accept returns on plants.
If a rose, perennial, or bulb arrives with a condition concern, we ask you to contact us and share photos so our team can assess it.
Roses are covered by a one-year guarantee, perennials by a 90-day guarantee, and bulbs by a failure-to-bloom guarantee.

For non-plant items:

Standard returns are for unused items only.
Tools and hard goods can be returned within 30 days of delivery.
Return shipping is the customer’s responsibility.
Custom engraved Garden Markers are non-returnable.

For damaged non-plant items:

Those are reviewed as an issue with the item rather than a regular return.
We’ll ask for details and photos so the team can take a look.

You can also see the full policy here: Our Guarantee

If you want, send me the item type and whether it’s a plant or non-plant item, and I’ll tell you exactly what applies.
